summary.text: Thomas Jackson, also known as Action, is a Democratic state representative from Alabama House District 68 who took office in 1994 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Fred Kelley is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: His professional experience includes serving as an associate pastor at the Church of God in Christ and as director of the Upward Bound program at Alabama Southern Community College.
He has been a member of the Alabama Education Association, Kappa Alpha Psi, the Kiwanis Club, the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People and the National Education Association.
Jackson assumed office in the Alabama House in 1994.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Agriculture and Forestry; Ethics and Campaign Finance; House Local Legislation; and Public Safety and Homeland Security.
